biggest_catch: The $10 (or $30) bonus is paid through Tremendous — your choice of gift cards or prepaid rewards, not straight cash — and your friend must actually get selected and complete a study; just signing up earns nothing.
catches: The bonus is paid out through the incentives provider Tremendous (Amazon and other gift cards, prepaid rewards, charitable donations) — alternative payment forms are not available.
Community referral: friend must sign up via your link AND be selected and complete their first study; signup or application alone earns nothing.
Featured-study referral: friend must apply with your link to that specific study, be selected, and complete that specific study; completing a different study does not count.
There is no cap on the number of referrals you can make.
The program may not be available for all participants at all times and may be suspended at any time; check your referral page while logged in.
Fraudulent or suspicious referrals can cost you the bonus and your eligibility.
Referrals should be in a country User Interviews supports.
